description: This file defines the CustomerRepository class, which provides database access methods for customer-related data, such as counting, retrieving, inserting, and deleting customer records in a PostgreSQL database, using Spring's JdbcTemplate.

classes.name: CustomerRepository
classes.description: A Spring Repository class that manages customer data via JDBC operations.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of customers in the database.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all customer records from the database.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a customer by their ID, returning an Optional<CustomerDto>.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new customer record into the database and returns the created CustomerDto.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a customer record by ID.
